title: Blanche Calloway's records and Line of Jive
summary: Morgenstern has a Calloway record he thinks has Dickenson on a Swedish LP; Dickenson has never heard it and asks for a cassette.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Just to backtrack for a moment to Blanche Calloway, I think you got to make some records with that band.
Yeah. But I never did hear any of them, the ones I made.
You do have one that I'm on?
It recently came out on one of those Swedish LPs.
I've never heard it. I wish you'd make me a cassette of it.
Sure. I'll bring it around the next time.
Yeah, make me a little cassette. I'd like to hear that.
It sounds like a good band.
